newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austria H1 1996 trade deficit 54.9 bln ats.
newsitem.headline: Austria H1 1996 trade deficit 54.9 bln ats.

text.p: Austria's trade deficit in the first six months of 1996 widened by 11.5 billion schillings to a provisional 54.9 billion schillings, Austria's Statistical Office said on Wednesday.

The statistics office attributed the increase to a 3.6-percent rise in imports from EU-member states to 253.3 billion schillings. Exports to the EU rose 3.1 percent versus a year ago to 198.3 billion.
Overall imports rose 5.2 percent to 354.0 billion schillings, and exports climbed 2.1 percent to 299.1 billion.

Austrian trade date have been delayed by the rigours of conforming to EU standards. The statistics office said it hoped to release provisional data for the third quarter of 1996 at the end of March and full-year figures in May. -- Janet McBride, Vienna Newsroom, 53-1 12254
